# Code of Conduct

## Our pledge

We want participating in this project to be a harassment-free experience for
everyone, regardless of age, body size, visible or invisible disability,
ethnicity, sex characteristics, gender identity and expression, level of
experience, education, socioeconomic status, nationality, personal appearance,
race, religion, or sexual identity and orientation.

## Standards

Behaviour that helps:

- being respectful of differing opinions, viewpoints, and experiences;
- giving and gracefully accepting constructive feedback;
- accepting responsibility, apologising to those affected by our mistakes,
  and learning from the experience;
- focusing on what is best for the project and its community.

Behaviour that is not acceptable:

- sexualised language or imagery, and unwelcome sexual attention or advances;
- trolling, insulting or derogatory comments, and personal or political
  attacks;
- public or private harassment;
- publishing others' private information (doxxing) without explicit
  permission;
- other conduct that could reasonably be considered inappropriate in a
  professional setting.

## Enforcement

Instances of abusive, harassing, or otherwise unacceptable behaviour may be
**reported privately by contacting the maintainers via GitHub** — use a
private channel (a GitHub Security Advisory on this repository or a private
message to the maintainers); never open a public thread about a personal
conduct complaint. All complaints are reviewed promptly and treated fairly;
the reporter's identity is kept confidential to the extent practical.

Maintainers are responsible for clarifying and enforcing these standards and
will take appropriate, fair corrective action in response to any behaviour they
deem inappropriate, threatening, offensive, or harmful. Maintainers who do not
follow or enforce this Code of Conduct in good faith may face consequences
determined by the project owners.

## Attribution

This Code of Conduct is adapted from the
[Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org), version 2.1.
